featured_reviews.name: Avinash Zire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located near Pestom Sagar Road No. 4 in Chembur, Flavours Of China is a great destination for anyone who loves authentic and flavour-packed Chinese cuisine. The restaurant is easy to locate and sits in a lively area, making it convenient for both quick meals and relaxed dining with friends or family. As you enter, you’re welcomed by a cozy ambience, neat interiors, and comfortable seating that instantly puts you at ease.

One of the highlights of Flavours Of China is the food quality, especially the soups. The soup is absolutely delicious—rich in flavour, perfectly seasoned, and served hot, making it a perfect start to the meal. It feels comforting and freshly prepared, setting the tone for the rest of the dining experience. From classic Chinese starters to hearty main-course dishes, every item reflects attention to taste and presentation. The balance of spices is impressive, and the ingredients feel fresh and well cooked.

The menu offers a good variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, so everyone finds something they enjoy. Portions are generous, and the food is filling without being overly heavy. Noodles, rice dishes, and gravies are all prepared with consistent quality, making the restaurant a reliable choice for repeat visits.

Service here deserves special mention. The staff are polite, attentive, and quick to respond, ensuring that orders arrive on time and any requests are handled smoothly. Pricing is reasonable and offers good value for money considering the taste, portion size, and overall experience.

Overall, Flavours Of China near Pestom Sagar Road No. 4 is a solid choice for Chinese food lovers. With delicious soup, tasty dishes, friendly service, and a pleasant ambience, it’s definitely worth visiting if you’re in Chembur.

featured_reviews.name: ravindra gomase
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good food overall, but a few misses in what I ordered

I liked the food overall, though some dishes worked better than others.

I had the Signature Ramen. The broth was quite good, and I really enjoyed the variety of toppings — squid, prawns, chicken, bamboo shoots, veggies, and boiled egg. The toppings were definitely the highlight. That said, I didn’t like the thickness of the noodles, which was a bit of a turn-off. Also, the prawns were not the best, while the other toppings were more enjoyable.

I was initially planning to order Nasi Goreng, but went with the Spicy Bangkok Fried Rice instead — and unfortunately, that turned out to be the wrong choice. The rice texture was nice, but the overall flavor and spice level were underwhelming. It came with fried tofu, which had an amazing texture — crispy on the outside and melt-in-the-mouth inside — but the tofu itself was quite bland.

I feel like this place has a lot to offer, but I probably just picked the wrong dishes this time.

Visited this place with my friends after hearing a lot about it, and it truly lived up to the expectations. We had a fantastic experience—both the food and the overall vibe were excellent.

We ordered Bombil fry as a starter, along with Prawns Thali and Surmai Thali. Every single dish was 10/10. Personally, whenever I try a new place for fish, I judge it by the taste of the Bombil fry—and this one was outstanding. It was extremely fresh, perfectly crispy, and the masala was well balanced and nicely blended.

The same quality and freshness reflected in the Surmai and Prawns thali—authentic taste and very satisfying portions.

On the owner’s suggestion, we also tried their Mutton Thali for a change, and it was surprisingly excellent. The mutton was fresh, tender, and full of flavour, which is rare to find these days.

If you’re a seafood lover, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy quality fish with great taste and vibes.

featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent ambience, inconsistent food preparation standards and a negligent service sums up our three visits to the china bistro branch at R city mall. There is a huge wait time during weekends and still we patiently waited almost every time to dine at this restaurant.
Our first visit was absolutely wonderful as the ambience was classy, quieter environment and delicious food (namely eight treasure soup, crispy lotus stem, chilli cheese snow peas dumplings, chilly garlic noodles and so on) accompanied by warm,thoughtful and great service.
But sadly there ends our good experiences at this restaurant.

The next visit left us with just soup appetizers as the dishes ordered were appalling and quite different in taste (ordered same dishes). The service staff have still continued to bill us for the ordered items inspite of the fact that we left without having them. This already showed a lack of good fallback approach by the service crew.

Our recent visit was after a few months  and the experience was much more pathetic to say the least. The tables weren't kept ready with necessary water glasses, accompaniments,cutlery - none whatsoever. We had to request for drinking water in the middle of having our meal in an emergency. Quite unlike a service you'd expect at a fine-dine. After serving us the dimsums/sushi that we had ordered...we then had to notice that the accompaniments lying on the tables weren't refilled/replenished before we were seated. When an additional chilli oil was requested it was placed on the table with oil oozing out everywhere on the table. The accompaniments had no spoons to serve them. When one of the serving crew were initially called to refill drinking water,they simply moved away without a word to do some personal chores leaving us unattended. We are baffled at the standards of service and food that chine bistro maintains at this outlet in R city. We had also overheard from the nearby table that they are forced to call for service multiple times for pretty small things. We had also called a member of the staff and notified them of their negligent service to which they simply apologized and left.

This marks the end of our visits of the restaurant and sad to see that there's zero turnaround from the staff and diminishing standards overall.

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh Bandiwdekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited China Bristo and overall, it was a delightful culinary experience with a few hiccups.

What Went Wrong:
Unfortunately, I had to deduct one point due to an unpleasant incident at the entry. Despite having a paid booking for 8 PM, we were asked by the receptionist (Mis. Grace) to vacate the table we had just taken—while other tables were still vacant. This was after the waiter initially guided us to sit. It felt disorganized and unprofessional, especially for a confirmed reservation. Reception etiquette needs improvement.

Food:
The food was absolutely excellent. We ordered four different dishes, and each one was cooked to perfection—rich in flavor, beautifully presented, and satisfying in every way. If you’re looking for authentic taste and quality, this place delivers.

Service:
Once we were seated, the service was awesome. The staff was attentive, courteous, and ensured we had everything we needed throughout the meal.

Atmosphere:
The ambience was soothing and calming, making it a great spot for a relaxed dining experience. The interiors and lighting added to the overall comfort.

Final Verdict:
Amazing food and great service once you’re seated, but the entry experience needs better handling.
Rating: ★★★★☆ (4/5)

featured_reviews.name: Juliano Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
A deeply disappointing dinner experience — surprising for a brand like WOW! China, especially at a high-footfall location such as Phoenix Marketcity, Kurla.

We arrived around 10 PM after shopping, hoping for a quick, comforting meal. What followed highlighted poor service standards and a lack of basic operational readiness.
•	Ordered the Khaali Thali (10-item platter) — Not available.
•	Tried the Burmese Khow Suey — Not available.
•	Requested a Thums Up —  not chilled.

Trying to stay patient, we settled for a Chicken Overload Sizzler — average at best, with very little “overload” to justify the name. Ironically, the 250 ml Coke served alongside was the only thing perfectly chilled that evening.

Next, we ordered Schezwan Rice with Chicken Chilly. To our surprise, it was completely pale and bland — no chilli, no heat, and no colour. When my wife politely asked the server why it looked so different, the response was an indifferent, “We serve it like this.” No effort to check or apologize — just a lack of interest.

To close the experience, the POS machine wasn’t working, delaying the payment process unnecessarily.

It’s clear that this outlet suffers from poor staff training, lack of supervision, and minimal ownership towards guest satisfaction. Availability issues can happen — but attitude, attentiveness, and communication define a dining experience. On that front, this visit failed completely.

Overall Verdict:
Below-average food, disorganized service, and a team that seems disengaged. A serious quality and management review is needed before this outlet can live up to the WOW! brand name.

featured_reviews.name: Aniruddha Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stopped by Chinese Wok in R City, Ghatkopar, and here's my take:

*Food:*
The menu boasts a range of Chinese classics, and I was impressed by the flavors and freshness. Highlights included:

- Shezwan dishes with perfect numbing spice
- Fresh, well-balanced sauces
- Generous portions

Some dishes felt slightly oily, but overall, the food was satisfying.

*Service:*
The staff was attentive and friendly, with a noticeable effort to ensure a good experience. Orders were taken promptly, and servers were knowledgeable about the menu.

*Ambiance:*
Chinese Wok's decor is simple yet cozy, with a warm atmosphere. The seating arrangement is comfortable, making it suitable for casual gatherings.

*Value:*
Prices are reasonable, with most dishes falling in the ₹200-₹400 range. Considering the quality and quantity, it's good value.

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Panda's Plate, an Asian pan restaurant that truly impressed me. The food was very delicious—especially the sushi and momos, which were fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The menu offers a great variety of Asian dishes that cater to different tastes, all prepared with high-quality ingredients. The service was excellent; the staff was friendly, attentive, and helpful with recommendations. The ambiance was cozy and modern, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Overall, Panda's Plate delivers a fantastic dining experience, and I’ll definitely be coming back for more.
